art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: capable, heroic-but-calm readiness — gear preparation, never depicting an accident or victim
forbidden: injured person, stretcher, or medical distress imagery

riasec_accent.use: carabiner gate, rope end-cap, jacket cuff stripe

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct build, skin tone and hairstyle from every other questionnaire character

pose.stance: full body, standing, one foot slightly forward in a ready stance
pose.action: coiling an orange rescue rope over one shoulder while clipping a carabiner onto a loop of harness webbing at her waist with the other hand

top.detail: dark charcoal collar, teal reflective-style cuff stripe

subject.scene_narrative: A young woman stands in a ready stance, coiling an orange rescue rope over one shoulder while clipping a carabiner onto a loop of harness webbing at her waist. A compass and whistle hang from her belt. Calm, methodical readiness — preparing to help, never depicting an accident, victim, or crisis — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references.
subject.hero_prop: coiled orange rescue rope with a teal end-cap slung over the shoulder
supporting_props: aluminum carabiner clipped to webbing loop
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure centered slightly left, rope coil and gear right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + rope coil readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter R, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, injured person, stretcher, medical distress, industrial horror, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young college-age woman, athletic strong build, medium tan skin #C8956C, braided ponytail pulled back, standing in a ready stance with one foot forward. She wears a purple #4B2C7F technical rescue jacket with charcoal collar and teal #4DB6AC reflective-style cuff stripe, dark cargo pants with a harness webbing loop at the waist, and hiking boots. She coils an orange rescue rope with a teal end-cap over one shoulder while clipping an aluminum carabiner onto the webbing loop with her other hand. A simple compass and a rescue whistle with a lavender #9575CD cord hang from her belt. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Mood: calm, capable emergency-readiness — gear preparation, never an accident or victim scene. Full head-to-feet visible.
